source.section: Schedule M line 34 Social Security Benefits, 100% at or under the AGI limit and 65% above it for 2025 (PDF p.5; instructions PDF p.28; PDF p.17; Tax Division Social Security Modification page); IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: Single, age 62, wages and Social Security, federal AGI under 50,000: line 34 takes 100% of the taxable benefits. Under 65, so line 47 does not apply. filer born 1963-03-10, age 62 at December 31, 2025. Federal taxable Social Security (IRS worksheet, given): other income 30,000.00 + half of benefits 9,000.00 = provisional income 39,000.00; 85% x (39,000.00 - 34,000.00) = 4,250.00 + lesser of 4,500.00 and half the benefits 9,000.00 = 8,750.00, limited to 85% of benefits 15,300.00: 8,750.00. Federal AGI (given) = wages 30,000.00 + taxable Social Security 8,750.00 = 38,750.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 38,750.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 23,000.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 38,750.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M Column A: line 34(a) total benefits 18,000.00, (b) exempt for federal 9,250.00, (c) taxable 8,750.00; federal AGI 38,750.00 does not exceed 50,000.00, so line 34 = 8,750.00 (100%); line 47: age 62, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 8,750.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 8,750.00. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 8,750.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 38,750.00 + 0.00 - 8,750.00 = 30,000.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 1 x 2,000.00 = 2,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 30,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 28,000.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule I (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 10,000.00 = 222 + 2.96% x 15,000.00 = 444 + 3.33% x 3,000.00 = 99.9; total 765.9 = 765.90. The Tax Table row 28,000 to under 28,060 (PDF p.38 on) gives 767; expected keeps the schedule formula on the exact income. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 765.90.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
